profile.headline: Master Software Engineer at USSOCOM (US Special Operation Command)
profile.summary: Master Level 'Full Stack' Software Engineer with proven technology leadership and management. Experienced in team building, mentoring and training. Long term enterprise development experience in Defense and Financial Services industries.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Providing technical services to the Department of War in a highly secured environment.

positions.title: Application Developer, IT Financial Crime Investigation
positions.description:
I worked on the AML (Anti-Money Laundering) team as a Full Stack developer in a highly compliant and audited financial environment. I developed applications supporting: KYC, CIP, PEP, Negative News, Patriot Act, Sanctions and Counter Terrorism.

Technologies: C#, .NET, MVC, MS SQL Server, T-SQL, Oracle, PL/SQL BMC Control-M, Angular, TypeScript, Stored Procedures, Packages, JavaScript, TFS, Spectrum, SSIS, SSMS, Neo4j, Postman, ServiceNow, Genesis, Jenkins, Mantas – OFSAA FCCM, RDC, Node

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked in the Retirement Solutions division and provided full stack custom financial services software development. Completed a complex Compliance Intelligence System for fiduciary responsibilities used by one of the largest financial companies.  

Technologies: C#, Angular, Web API, Microservices, MVC, WCF, MS SQL, Stored Procedures, SSRS JavaScript, Bootstrap, JQuery, CSS, HTML5, IIS, AJAX, Git, JSON,

positions.title: Principal Functional Analyst / Software Engineer (Team Lead)
positions.description:
The project was ‘Phase 3’ of the Comprehensive Everglades Restoration Plan (CERP) which was the “The world’s largest ecosystem restoration project.”

Lead team of technical and design professionals (local and external). Managed internet projects and products. Handled and controlled highly visible and emergency situations.

I started the project on day one in a green field environment, took ownership and followed through to the last day. Based on my performance of leadership and technical skills, I was promoted into one of the highest technical positions (Principal) in this $8 billion dollar project.

Provided service to the US Department of Defense in a complex hybrid government agency environment.  Project was 14 years and was managed by multiple companies including, Lockheed Martin, Computer Sciences Corporation and Chickasaw Nation Industries. 

Technologies: C#, MVC, ASP.NET, MS SQL, Entity Framework, IIS, Ninject, SVN, XP (Extreme Programming / Agile), JQuery, Ajax, CSS, JavaScript, Team City

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
The project was ‘Phase 2’ of the Comprehensive Everglades Restoration Plan (CERP).

The project spanned 14 years with multiple companies. See full description listed under Lockheed Martin.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
The project was ‘Phase 1’ of the Comprehensive Everglades Restoration Plan (CERP).

The project spanned 14 years with multiple companies. See full description listed under Lockheed Martin.

positions.title: Director of Research & Development / Software Development Manager
positions.description:
BarPoint.com was a search engine shopping facilitator based on Universal Product Codes (UPC’s).  The services were accessible on a wide range of devices including PC’s, PDA’s and mobile phones. Technology, patents and other intellectual property are now owned by Alphabet (Google).

Assisted in the growth of a single room start-up business to a $240 million dollar NASDAQ company.  I played many roles during the massive growth of my company.  I built a incredible team of professionals, helped to create a success driven culture, managed all aspects of internet development,  analyzed large scale complex data, designed databases, developed algorithms for search engine, creating software for pervasive devises, made prototypes and proofs of concepts, invented new business products and services, and gave executive level presentations to Fortune 500 companies.
